title.zh-CN: 婴儿自出生无力、发育落后并出现抽搐
title.en: Weakness and developmental delay from birth with new seizures

summary.zh-CN: 婴儿自出生即无力，训练效果不佳，家中曾有类似早发病程，需重新评估病因。
summary.en: An infant has weakness from birth, poor response to rehabilitation and a sibling with a similar early course.

provenance.citation: 马艳艳, 吴桐菲, 刘玉鹏, 王峤, 宋金青, 马祎楠, 张尧, 王松涛, 王玉洁, 戚豫, 杨艳玲. ATP6基因8993T>G突变导致的单纯线粒体ATP合成酶缺陷一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(07):557-558. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.07.018.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: Current GeneReviews mtDNA-associated Leigh spectrum, checked 2026-10-28; scope molecular interpretation, heteroplasmy and multisystem support; m.8993T>G protein annotation checked against table.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.en: Recognise red flags in progressive hypotonia.
Integrate metabolic, MRI and enzymatic evidence.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 发育落后、全身无力，近一个月反复抽搐
chiefComplaint.en: Developmental delay and generalised weakness with recurrent seizures over the last month

question.zh-CN: 从出生后活动和发育怎样？
question.en: How were activity and development from birth?

answer.zh-CN: 一直全身软、活动少、哭声小，智力运动发育落后。
answer.en: The infant was floppy with little activity, a weak cry and delayed mental/motor development from birth.

question.zh-CN: 抽搐什么时候开始，多久一次？
question.en: When did seizures start and how often?

answer.zh-CN: 九个月时开始全身抽搐，每两三天一次。
answer.en: Generalised seizures began at nine months, occurring every two or three days.

finding.zh-CN: 不能竖头，不追物或逗笑，四肢肌张力低、肌力Ⅲ级，膝反射可引出；营养不良、毛发稀黄。
finding.en: Unable to hold the head, track objects or smile socially; low limb tone, grade III strength and elicitable knee reflexes, with poor nutrition and sparse light hair.

text.zh-CN: 乳酸6.1 mmol/L、丙酮酸276 µmol/L，HCO3 21.7 mmol/L；常规氨基酸、酰基肉碱和尿有机酸筛查无异常。MRI双侧基底节和大脑脚对称异常。原文丙酮酸参考单位不一致，未照抄为校准范围。
text.en: Lactate 6.1 mmol/L, pyruvate 276 µmol/L and bicarbonate 21.7 mmol/L; routine amino-acid, acylcarnitine and urine organic-acid screening was normal. MRI showed symmetrical basal-ganglia and cerebral-peduncle abnormalities. Inconsistent source pyruvate reference units are not reproduced as a validated interval.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞复合物V活性28 nmol/(min·mg线粒体总蛋白)，I–IV正常。MT-ATP6 m.8993T>G在患儿血中约90%、母亲45%，父亲未检出。
text.en: Leucocyte complex V activity was 28 nmol/(min·mg mitochondrial protein), with I–IV normal. Blood MT-ATP6 m.8993T>G heteroplasmy was approximately 90% in the child and 45% in the mother, and not detected in the father.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些线索要求超出静态脑瘫诊断？
prompt.en: Which clues require assessment beyond a static cerebral palsy label?

need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 进展、同胞相似病程、乳酸和对称深部脑损害提示遗传代谢病
text.en: Progression, a similar sibling course, lactate and symmetrical deep-brain lesions suggest inherited metabolic disease

feedback.zh-CN: 多种证据支持继续病因检查，普通筛查正常不能排除线粒体病。
feedback.en: Convergent evidence supports further assessment; normal routine screening does not exclude mitochondrial disease.

text.zh-CN: 没有出生窒息仍可直接认定窒息脑损伤
text.en: Asphyxial brain injury is established despite no birth asphyxia

feedback.zh-CN: 原文没有支持这个原因，且病程进展。
feedback.en: The source does not support that cause and the course is progressive.

text.zh-CN: 代谢筛查正常排除全部遗传病
text.en: Normal screening excludes all genetic disease

feedback.zh-CN: 筛查并未覆盖所有线粒体功能或基因异常。
feedback.en: Screening does not cover every mitochondrial function or genetic abnormality.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 酶学和MT-ATP6结果支持复合物V相关Leigh谱系病，异质性比例不能保证个体结局
text.en: Enzyme and MT-ATP6 findings support complex-V-related Leigh spectrum disease; heteroplasmy does not guarantee an individual outcome

feedback.zh-CN: 这里有实际分子证据；母亲无症状不排除携带。
feedback.en: Actual molecular evidence is present; an asymptomatic mother can carry the variant.

text.zh-CN: 父亲阴性证明常染色体显性遗传
text.en: A negative father proves autosomal dominant inheritance

feedback.zh-CN: 此结果属于线粒体DNA，不能套用该模式。
feedback.en: These are mitochondrial DNA findings and do not establish that pattern.

text.zh-CN: 应直接沿用原文所有蛋白变异注释
text.en: Every historical protein annotation should be copied

feedback.zh-CN: 当前GeneReviews将m.8993T>G列为p.Leu156Arg；原文相关注释有冲突。
feedback.en: Current GeneReviews lists m.8993T>G as p.Leu156Arg, conflicting with the historical annotation.

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 代谢遗传与神经专科联合关注吞咽、呼吸、癫痫及家族咨询
text.en: Metabolic/genetic and neurological teams should address swallowing, respiration, seizures and family counselling

feedback.zh-CN: 实际功能风险和家庭解释重要，不能承诺补充剂逆转病程。
feedback.en: Functional risks and family counselling matter; supplements cannot be promised to reverse the course.

text.zh-CN: 保证维生素和辅酶一定治愈
text.en: Guarantee cure with vitamins and coenzyme

feedback.zh-CN: 单例和现有证据不支持这种保证。
feedback.en: Neither this report nor the checked evidence supports that promise.

text.zh-CN: 母亲健康说明孩子无需随访

feedback.zh-CN: 异质性与临床表达可不同，孩子已有显著损害。
feedback.en: Heteroplasmy and expression differ and the child has established impairment.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明病程和家族史提示进行性病因。；承认完整现代测序、组织异质性及长期呼吸结局未知。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Course and family history suggest a progressive cause.; acknowledge Comprehensive modern sequencing, tissue heteroplasmy and long-term respiratory outcomes are unknown. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 实际酶学和分子结果支持MT-ATP6 m.8993T>G相关复合物V缺陷及Leigh表型。
conclusion.en: Enzymatic and molecular findings support MT-ATP6 m.8993T>G-related complex V deficiency with a Leigh phenotype.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病程和家族史提示进行性病因。
keyReasoning.en: Course and family history suggest a progressive cause.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: MRI和代谢资料提供互补线索。
keyReasoning.en: MRI and metabolic results provide complementary clues.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 基因证据比旧文术语更可追溯。
keyReasoning.en: The nucleotide finding is more traceable than conflicting historical annotation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 普通筛查阴性不等于代谢病阴性。
teachingPoints.en: Negative routine screening is not exclusion of metabolic disease.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不要复制存在冲突的蛋白注释。
teachingPoints.en: Do not copy conflicting protein annotation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 家系比例不能给出确定预后。
teachingPoints.en: Family heteroplasmy does not give a certain prognosis.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整现代测序、组织异质性及长期呼吸结局未知。
unknowns.en: Comprehensive modern sequencing, tissue heteroplasmy and long-term respiratory outcomes are unknown.
